title: Humans in the Loop
author: Seb Agertoft
description: Humans in the Loop, hosted by Seb Agertoft, is a podcast for thoughtful technologists asking the hard questions at the intersection of technology and society. Guests include founders, investors, researchers, artists, policymakers and even a Zen Master, covering topics like the AI bubble debate, tech sovereignty, the Chinese tech industry, radicalisation and conspiracy theories, AGI, quantum computing, technology and democracy, the future of work, and much more. Seb is a coach to tech company founders and leadership teams. You can find out more about his work at www.theuncommonfounder.com
